editorial.focus: Tree layers have different jobs and locations. Growth rings often reflect yearly cycles in temperate trees, but counting rings is not an infallible rule for every tree or growing condition.
editorial.solvingTip: Location words matter here: outside, growing layer, and center point to different tree parts. Use those distinctions before filling the crossings.

answerNotes.text: Heartwood is distinct from the water-conducting sapwood. Its presence and color vary among tree species.
Sapwood is the outer functional wood. Older inner wood may become heartwood.
The vascular cambium produces new tissues in a woody stem. It lies between the wood and the inner bark.

Oaks include many species with different leaves, bark, and growing habits.

answerNotes.text: Mycelium is a network of hyphae; the visible mushroom is only one possible fruiting structure produced by a fungus.
